title: Transit rows
desc: Full CTA names and up to five times a row; the header keeps the station and clock.

title: Transit, by direction
desc: Belmont split north | south, two times or more per line. The station and clock move to the bottom.
note: Real Belmont times (Oct 3, 11:16 PM, no Purple).

title: Ticker
desc: After the CTA platform signs: the row number in the grey column, the full destination, the time at the far right, then the live-train signal, or a clock for a scheduled train (row 2).
note: Real Morse times; the Howard train is marked scheduled here to show the clock.

title: Chronological, two columns
desc: Eight trains instead of four, with full names (FOREST PK, 54/CERMAK).

title: Busy station: five rows
desc: Clark/Lake's five destinations as destination rows with full names and up to four times; the header drops to make room, as it does on the 64 board.

title: Busy station: two columns
desc: Eight destinations in two columns of four under the header: Clark/Lake at rush. With the 64 board's short names (HARLEM, 63RD, 54/CRMK) every row keeps three times.

title: Busy station: one row per line
desc: Five lines on five rows; a line with two destinations puts the second at the halfway mark (Blue: O'HARE and FOREST). Short names, as on the 64 board.
note: Made-up times. Seven destinations, no paging.

title: 7-day forecast
desc: Seven columns with highs and lows; the 64 screen shows five days and highs only.

title: 7-day, top bar on
desc: The current-conditions bar as an option: with it on, the lows drop out.

title: Hourly, 24 hours
desc: Eight 3-hour steps under the top bar.
note: The server builds 4 slots today (HOUR_STEPS); the NWS hourly feed covers more.

title: Hourly, top bar off
desc: Without the bar the freed rows carry each slot's rain chance (bright from 20%).

title: Radar, 128 wide
desc: A real MRMS frame (the Aug 10, 2020 derecho) cropped 128 LEDs wide, the time over the lake. Works for Morse, but no fixed spot for the time box is open water for all stations: it fails at 56 of 144 (the South Side and the Loop, where the box reaches the Indiana shore).
note: Checked against every station in stations.json with the lake outline.

title: Radar, split: Morse
desc: One layout for every station: the map on 96 columns with the station at x 52, so it shows about 78 mi west (where storms come from) and the lake to the Michigan shore; the time and conditions in a 31-column panel.
note: Real MRMS frame, Aug 10, 2020, 4 PM (the derecho).

title: Radar, split: 95th/Dan Ryan
desc: The same layout at a South Side station, where no fixed spot over the lake works for the time.

title: Baseball line score
desc: Runs by inning, R H E, then the count, outs, pitch count and bases.
note: The innings come in the linescore the server already fetches; the pitch count would need a field added.

title: Message note
desc: About 21 characters a line in 5x7 instead of 10.

title: Key layout
desc: The column key on the top row (trains to, min), with the station and clock between them instead of moving to the bottom.

title: Alerts on rows
desc: The full destination, the red alert circle, then the alert's short label in red. At 64 the name is cut to fit the circle and there's no label.
note: The label needs a new payload field: today the board only knows that a line has a major alert.

title: Overnight
desc: The owl, big clock and NO TRAINS as on 64; the right side shows now and tomorrow. No data and stale keep this layout with NO DATA and the red line across the top.
note: Tomorrow comes from the NWS forecast the board already gets.

title: Current conditions
desc: A 2x icon and the temperature in the clock digits, high/low and date under them; the readout (sky, feels, wind, rain, sunset) beside, with dot leaders.

title: Rain bars
desc: The eight quarter-hours across the full width, 16 px each, with time marks under them; light, moderate and heavy in three blues.

title: Warning strip
desc: The warning spelled out on the bottom strip: funnel, TORNADO WARNING and the expiry, with the temperature at left.
note: The 64 strip has room for WARNING only. Blinks as it does now.

title: Gradient clock
desc: The same block digits widened to 21 x 30 (7 x 6 blocks) so the time fills the width as it does at 64; the gradient spans all 128 columns.

title: Typewriter
desc: About 21 characters a line instead of 10, so most notes fit in two lines. Shown mid-typing.

title: Big word
desc: At 3x instead of 2x: 21 px letters, up to about 7 characters; longer words drop to 2x (about 10).

title: Credits roll
desc: Wider lines mean fewer of them; the roll and its fade at the edges stay the same.

title: Knob chooser
desc: The peek chooser with room to name things: the chosen category and its variant are spelled out beside its icon, with one pip per variant under the name.
note: The view on top is the 7-day with the top bar.
